 An elderly groom in his 80s marries a woman 41 years younger, driving his supercar to pick up the bride.
 CHINA - At their wedding, the 73-year-old groom drove his red convertible to pick up his young bride. This car is part of his personal collection and is meticulously maintained.
 VietNamNet • 20/10/2026 Follow Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e Add Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e 0 The wedding of Mr. Lu Weiguo and Ms. Yu Zhongxin (32 years old) was held at the Pisces Club of the Hong Kong ( China ) Equestrian Club.
 The wedding was held privately. Afterwards, images shared on social media quickly attracted public attention, according to QQ .
 A special highlight of the wedding was the red Ferrari 348 convertible, driven by the groom himself to pick up the bride. This car is from Mr. Lu Wei Guo's personal collection and has been meticulously maintained.
 The car was manufactured in 1994, the same year as the bride's birth. This interesting coincidence made the red Ferrari the center of attention on the couple's big day. 
 The red Ferrari is exactly the same age as the bride. Photo: QQ The wedding venue also holds special significance. The bride, Yu Zhongxin, had interned in veterinary medicine at a Hong Kong equestrian club, while the groom owns racehorses.
 You may also like The bride's father, Mr. Yu Baoluo, is a renowned horse racing commentator in Hong Kong.
 The wedding had approximately 400 guests. Because the venue was far from the city center, the bride and groom hired buses to transport the guests. 
 The wedding of the couple with a significant age difference was held privately. Photo: QQ Besides the age difference, the bride's education and talent also attracted much attention. Du Trong Han showed artistic talent from a young age.
 The bride began learning Cantonese opera at the age of 5, took to the stage at 6, and won first prize three times in a row in the Hong Kong inter-school Cantonese opera competition during her primary school years.
 After studying biology-related subjects at McGill University (Canada), she returned to Hong Kong to pursue her dream of becoming a veterinarian. This year, she graduated from City University of Hong Kong with top honors and was granted her veterinary license.
 You may also like According to shared information, the relationship between the two families has lasted for more than 20 years. The bride's father, Mr. Du Ba Luo, has known Lu Wei Guo for 26 years. When Du Zhong Xin was a primary school student participating in Cantonese opera competitions, Mr. Lu already knew this woman. For a long time, Du Zhong Xin still called him "Uncle Lu".
 In 2018, the two performed Cantonese opera together on stage, playing the roles of husband and wife.
 The turning point in their relationship came in May of this year, after Yu Zhongxin completed his veterinary graduation exams. That night, the two talked all night, using the lyrics of a Cantonese song to express their feelings and officially confirming their romantic relationship.
 Just three weeks after establishing their relationship, wedding preparations were finalized. At the end of May, Lu Weiguo held a press conference to publicly announce their relationship.
